subject: Request: transient reservation hold + softened overage for H100 surge (Orpheus AI)
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orpheus.ai>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary reservation hold + softened overage while we migrate

Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. Quick ask from procurement: we have a seasonal spike starting June 8 for ~6 weeks where we need a transient H100 capacity uplift (~40% above our reserved commit). Our internal runbooks say we should avoid preemptions during the campaign window. Two asks:

- Can Redwood put a 6-week reservation hold on our current Dedicated pool so we don’t lose priority while we onboard new users?
- If H100s are capacity constrained next week, would you approve a temporary substitution to an H100 variant (same family) or an A100 fallback, and can we cap overage rates at 1.6x reserved for the burst period?

We’re willing to sign a short addendum and accept a modest premium if needed. I attached our campaign forecast and the current commit summary.

Appreciate quick guidance — we’re trying to finalize infra by Tuesday.

Best,
Daniel Park
Head of Infrastructure
Orpheus AI

Subject: Escalation: Orpheus AI — 6-week transient reservation hold + overage cap request (DEAL-2027-089)

Team —

Forwarding Orpheus’s ask. Key facts:
- Customer: Orpheus AI (Deal: DEAL-2027-089)
- Window: 2027-06-08 to 2027-07-19 (~6 weeks)
- Requested: Reservation hold on current Dedicated pool + cap overage at 1.6x for burst window. Also asks for H100-family substitution or A100 fallback as required.
- Business rationale: Launch campaign drives ~+40% tokens/day; losing priority would materially disrupt product launch and could delay payment.
- Attachments: forecast + commit summary + proposed redlines (attached).

What I recommend:
1) Approve a temporary reservation hold for the existing pool for the 6-week window (no change to base commit).
2) Approve softened overage cap at 1.6x for the window, provided we set a hard cap on total overage spend (recommend $150k cap).
3) Allow automatic substitution within the H100 family; allow an A100 fallback only if customer explicitly signs the performance-impact addendum.

Jonas — can you attach a quick cost/runbook estimate if approved (delta to revenue, expected gross margin hit for the window)?

Please advise if you need more detail. This is time-sensitive — Daniel wants final language Tuesday morning to send to procurement.

Thanks,
Vanessa

[attachment: proposed_terms_redlines.docx (docx, 42KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Orpheus AI — 6-week transient reservation hold + overage cap request (DEAL-2027-089)

Quick numbers (assumes US H100 market pricing as of 2027-05-31):
- Expected burst consumption: +40% of committed tokens → estimated incremental usage 2.2M token-hours (approx).
- Overage at 1.6x would reduce margin on incremental usage to ~22% vs standard overage margin ~38%.
- Estimated incremental revenue: $182,000; recommended spend cap $150,000 to limit downside and keep upside sharing minimal.
- Operational impact: Capacity Ops confirms H100-family available but only two weeks of firm availability before we would consider A100 fallback. If fallback is required, perf delta ~5–8% for their workload; would need explicit sign-off from Orpheus.

Recommendation: Approve Vanessa’s proposed terms (temporary hold + 1.6x overage capped at $150k) and require the customer to sign a one-paragraph addendum acknowledging substitution rules and performance risk for A100.

I’ve saved a short cost workbook to the deal folder: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2027-089 (see "Cost").

—Jonas
Sales Ops

Thanks team — I reviewed Vanessa's summary and Jonas's numbers. I approve the following executive exceptions for Orpheus AI given the launch risk and strategic nature of the account:

1) Approve 6-week reservation hold on existing Dedicated pool between 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-19.
2) Approve overage cap at 1.6x for incremental usage during the window, with a hard spend cap of $150,000.
3) Allow H100-family automatic substitution only; A100 fallback permitted only after customer signs the performance-impact addendum (language to be prepared by Legal).

Conditions:
- BizOps to record the approved spend cap and force a hard stop when reached.
- Require a DocuSign addendum executed by Orpheus by 2027-06-06 or the hold is void.
- No changes to base committed contract/term.

Vanessa — you have executive sign-off; please circulate the final addendum and update HubSpot with the DocuSign link once signed. Lauren — please confirm Legal will draft the one-paragraph addendum by EOD.

Steph
